title: 里昂证券梁：AI板块调整，超大规模企业更抗跌？
speaker: Eleanor Leung

segments.en: Why do you think things have been so bad sentiment-wise for China tech? And the AI trade basically went from a very hot bet to someone of some losing strategy as well.
segments.zh: 为什么中国科技股的市场情绪这么差？AI交易从热门押注变成了某种亏损策略。

segments.en: Right. If you look at this, it's that all the hyper-scale I got punished because they are in the investment mode.
segments.zh: 对，你看，所有超大规模企业都受到惩罚，因为它们处于投入模式。

segments.en: For Baba, both Baba 10s that we see earning decline and CapEx jump.
segments.zh: 对阿里来说，我们看到阿里10s盈利下降而资本开支跳升。

segments.en: And that is not a very pretty picture. In the same time, they need to raise money in order to fund the CapEx expansion.
segments.zh: 这不是很漂亮的画面。同时，它们需要融资来支持资本开支扩张。

segments.en: So that is understandable why it underperforms this year.
segments.zh: 所以今年表现落后是可以理解的。

segments.en: And lately, people is also worried about the sustainability of these AI growth.
segments.zh: 最近，人们也担心这些AI增长的可持续性。

segments.en: And because of the US election, because of the MV, the incident, and people worry about that the data center bill is going to slow down.
segments.zh: 由于美国大选、MV事件，人们担心数据中心账单会放缓。

segments.en: So even the hardware guy corrected when it corrected, China also corrected along with it.
segments.zh: 所以即使硬件股回调时，中国也跟着回调。

segments.en: In our view is that hyper-scale actually is a lot more resilient compared to hot wear guy because the revenue is recurring.
segments.zh: 我们认为超大规模企业比硬件股更有韧性，因为收入是经常性的。

segments.en: So if you look at Baba growing the revenue by 64%, it's driven by 67% recurring revenue.
segments.zh: 你看阿里收入增长64%，是由67%的经常性收入驱动的。

segments.en: Because once the agent on your cloud is there forever and they will continue to pay for it, not going to cut your agent workforce in the future.
segments.zh: 因为云上的代理一旦部署就永久存在，他们会持续付费，未来不会削减代理团队。

segments.en: So the hyper-scale revenue actually is a lot more resilient compared to the hot wear guy.
segments.zh: 因此超大规模收入相比热门硬件更具韧性。

segments.en: And the other hand is that China never have SARS in the past. So China will also leapfraud straight into agentic software.
segments.zh: 另一方面，中国过去从未经历SARS，因此也将直接跃入代理软件时代。

segments.en: China AI application creation could be a lot faster compared to overseas because there was nothing to something.
segments.zh: 中国AI应用创造可能比海外快得多，因为是从无到有。

segments.en: So we are quite bullish on the AI application creation in China and that is going to drive the demand.
segments.zh: 所以我们相当看好中国AI应用创造，这将驱动需求。

segments.en: And China White CapEx is much lower compared to overseas. We are more focused on application instead of model iteration.
segments.zh: 中国白皮书资本支出远低于海外，我们更关注应用而非模型迭代。

segments.en: In some of these internet firms that you talk about, the hyper-scale, they are very cheap
segments.zh: 在你谈到的一些互联网公司中，超大规模企业非常便宜。
